allDay: All-day calendar event · reminder at 09:00 in the calendar timezone
invalid: Use a valid exact date and time. Completion must be in the past; reminder times must be in the future. Ambiguous local times need an ISO offset.
stale: This occurrence changed. Open it again for current controls.
failure: The schedule could not be updated. Try again later.
capacity: You have reached the private schedule limit. Pause an existing schedule before adding another.
configured: Your private follow-up and quiet-hour preferences are saved.
paused: Schedule paused. Completion history is retained.
connect: Choose Google calendars and events in your private dashboard.
notConfigured: The private dashboard URL is not configured.
exportTooLarge: Your full history exceeds the Discord attachment limit. Export it from your private dashboard.
